$comment: Extracted from brand/character-bible.html (Claude Design, Nov 2026). The bible is the source of truth: if this file and the bible disagree, the bible wins. Every value below is copied from it; nothing is invented. Decisions taken with the owner where the bible was open are listed under owner_decisions.

brand.name: Daymoom
brand.naming_rule: Every user-visible string says Daymoom, in the Arabic copy too (written in Latin script).
brand.app_purpose: Social habit/accountability app built around squads: members check in daily before a deadline to keep personal and team streaks alive, with shields, nudges and squad chat.

owner_decisions.body_colour: orange #D9431E or teal #2FA59B (owner's style prompt; the earlier blue choice is superseded) — final pick pending
owner_decisions.ground: light: cream #F4EFE6 or soft peach, so lines are ink per the bible
owner_decisions.voice: The Balloon will speak (a cool, calm voice). Engine (API vs open-source TTS) not chosen yet. Until then videos ship with an original music bed + SFX, and every script carries the voice lines ready for TTS.
owner_decisions.languages: Mixed per video: English voice + Arabic text, English voice + English text, Arabic (Egyptian) voice + Arabic text.
owner_decisions.end_card: No app marketing for now (goal = reach and follows). End card is the Daymoom icon + name only, max 1.5s.
owner_decisions.persona_direction: Owner, Nov 2026: the Balloon is a very charismatic narrator who takes the subject seriously: tells stories, wisdom and statistics with presence, in the spirit of the YouTube channel @QuietWolfz (reference short: youtube.com/shorts/WZT83CvG8Fo). Batch 1 style (flat captions-over-character) was rejected; the new style and scripts come from the owner. Fits the bible's 'calm, confident, never aggressive or sarcastic'; every statistic must be sourced.
owner_decisions.style: Superseded the batch-1 dark style. See brand/style-prompts.md: cream/peach ground, outlined white word-by-word captions with the key word in the body colour, source cards, a glasses glint after every punchline, lens reflections, hook in 2s → story → twist → one-line wisdom → soft ending; 30–70s; narrator or silent versions.

fixed_roles.ink: Glasses, brows and mouth — always, on any ground. Hands and string on light grounds.
fixed_roles.paper: Body highlight. Hands, string and line props on dark grounds.

blue.note: Default in prompts. Clear on light and dark.

display_latin.use: Headings and the zzz / ? glyphs in the bible (Latin only — never for Arabic)

character.name: The Balloon (البلونة)
character.concept: A round party balloon, slightly taller than wide, with a small knot and a thin string. Always wears round sunglasses. Thin line arms. No legs — the string is its tail.
character.personality: A calm, confident companion — not a loud cartoon. Celebrates with you without overdoing it; comforts you when you fall, without blame. Never aggressive, never sarcastic.
character.expression: The eyes are never visible. All feeling comes from three things: brows above the glasses, the mouth below them, and body + arm motion.

canvas.scale_rule: Scale everything by the same factor.

anatomy.body: Ellipse 150x180, y 30→210, centre x 120. One flat colour, no outline.
anatomy.highlight: Ellipse 18x40 rotated -28° at (82,72), paper at 42% opacity.
anatomy.knot: Trapezoid 12x9 under the body in the shade colour. Main pivot (120,218).
anatomy.string: Curve (120,218)→(120,298), width 2.5, sways ±5°. Slack and wavy when the streak is broken.
anatomy.glasses: Two ink circles r21 at (96,112) and (144,112) with a curved bridge; a glint line and a small dot on each lens.
anatomy.brows: Two curves 22 wide above the lenses at y≈80, width 4.5.
anatomy.mouth: Under the glasses at y≈150–160, 10–32 wide, width 4.5.
anatomy.arms: Line length 40, width 5, slight bend. Shoulders L (50,140), R (190,140). Arms rotate around the shoulder.
anatomy.hand: Solid circle r6.5, or palm / thumbs-up / 4 fingers depending on the state.
anatomy.deflated: streak_broken only: body 112x120 from y=88, face drops 40, shoulders drop to y=158, two wrinkles appear.

face_kit.rule: Glasses are fixed. A face = one of 6 brows + one of 9 mouths. All strokes 4.5, round caps. In video, change the brows first, then the mouth 2–3 frames later.

character.hands: No single raised finger in any state. Pointing is always an open palm.
character.props: Held in the right hand and stay upright whatever the arm does: flame, bell, magnifier, shield (to the right of the body, not in front), trophy.
character.fx: Outside the body group, don't move with it: zzz, sweat drop, stars, question mark, heart, motion lines, crossed wifi, burst lines.
character.implementation: src/character/Balloon.tsx is a frame-driven port of the bible's Balloon component (same paths, numbers and timings).

body.bounce: hop 28 with stretch (0.95,1.06), land squash (1.07,0.93), small hop 6; 1.1s loop, ease-out

parts.swing: wave between two arm angles (waving −135↔−172 @0.38s, confident −145↔−182 @0.28s, goodbye −140↔−165 @0.55s, cheering ±150↔±176 @0.24s)
parts.glint: glasses glint brightens at 88%, dims at 94%, 4.4s

video_rules.switching_states: No hard cut. Squash the body (1.05,0.95) over 3–4 frames, switch brows first then mouth and arms, then return with an overshoot like enter.
video_rules.loop: A state loop = 2× the body motion if it alternates (float 3.2s → 6.4s loop).
video_rules.face_leads: The expression changes 2–3 frames before the body.
video_rules.ground: Light ground → ink lines; dark ground → cream lines. No ground shadow; the balloon floats.
video_rules.framing: Leave room for the 28-unit bounce and the FX outside the body.
video_rules.sound: No voice or sound defined for the character in the bible; voice is a new decision (see owner_decisions).

do: Glasses on the face in every frame.
Expression from brows, mouth and body only.
Same proportions, colours and flat style in every shot.
Props always upright whatever the hand does.
Shield on the right of the body, not in front.
dont: Showing the eyes or removing the glasses.
A single raised finger. Pointing is an open palm.
The balloon popping or tearing. The most it does is deflate.
Legs, or an outline on the body.
Aggressive moves or mocking the user.

tone.voice: Calm, warm, confident, a little cool. Short sentences. Talks to one person.
tone.arabic: Egyptian dialect, RTL, Daymoom written in Latin script.
